folderNoteCompany: Tap the icon to choose its shape and color. Everyone in the company can see a shared folder and file mail into it; only admins or its creator can edit or delete it.

howToSetUp: See how to set it up

sameCredentials: Use the same username/password as the incoming server
scheduleInFuture: Set the scheduled time later than now.
securePasswordMin: Enter a secure-mail viewing password of at least 4 characters.
sendingInBackground: Sending your message. You can check it in Sent.
sharedAccountDeleteOnly: Only admins or the person who added it can delete a shared account
sharedAccountEditOnly: Only admins or the person who added it can edit a shared account
sharedAccountNoteCompany: Everyone in the company can read and send from this shared account's inbox and sent mail. Read and starred marks are shared; drafts are visible only to their author. Only admins or the person who added it can edit or delete it.
sharedAccountNoteTeam: Everyone on the team can read and send from this shared account's inbox and sent mail. Read and starred marks are shared; drafts are visible only to their author. Only team owners/admins or the person who added it can edit or delete it.
sharedContactEditOnly: Only admins or the person who added it can edit or delete a shared contact.
sharedFolderDeleteOnly: Only admins or the creator can delete a shared folder
sharedFolderEditOnly: Only admins or the creator can edit a shared folder
sharedFolderEmptyOnly: Only admins or the creator can empty a shared folder

signaturePlaceholder: Enter a signature (added to the end of your messages)

sourceRebuilt: The original isn't kept for mail fetched from external accounts, so this was rebuilt from the stored content (no delivery path or authentication headers).
sourceTruncated: The source is large ({{size}}), so only the beginning is shown. Use [Download] to see all of it.
subject: Subject
usernamePlaceholder: Leave blank to use the email address
